decisions.reason: Although adjacent to the machine-tool business, the minimum quantity lubrication system is the least central to the firm's core filtration and pumping portfolio, and its lack of visible follow-up after launch suggests limited traction versus stronger core opportunities.

The hydrocyclone coolant filter fits directly with the firm's core fluid-filtration offer and one-stop machine-tool solutions, so an expanding engineering-led firm would typically retain it as a modular core product.
The gravity band coolant filter is a standard close-to-core filtration product that supports the firm's broad systems portfolio and lifecycle service business, so it is worth keeping in the range.
